title: test(qa-scenarios): add the leave_balances mid-tier scenario card
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D5az28vj5D7FMGPRyuQEdi1)_
Fixes #30479
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:新增「请假与假期余额」中档场景卡:7 个对象(部门、员工、假期类型、假期余额、请假单、请假明细、审批步骤),3 天及以内只需经理审批、超过 3 天再加 HR 审批,批准后自动扣减余额;3 个角色其中 2 个按行限定;1 个请假天数报表;120 张请假单跨 7–10 月;10 道问数、6 个写操作、4 个 agent 动作。另配一份只属于这张卡的真值测试。
- **为什么改**:落实 cloud#3600 九个场景中的 HR 场景,让 AI 建应用、问数、代办写操作都有一张能用代码判分的请假与余额卡。
- **风险与回滚**:只加测试数据和测试,所在包私有、不发布,运行时零改动;回滚即删两个新文件。
- **先看**:① `docs/qa/scenarios/leave_balances.json` 的 `run.operations`(六个写操作及预期结果);② 同文件的 `run.questions` 与 `run.personas`;③ `packages/qa/scenarios/test/leave-balances.test.ts` 的 `EXPECTED_TRUTHS`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test`,预期 5 个测试文件、73 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `docs/qa/scenarios/leave_balances.json` (new): the 请假与假期余额 leave-and-balances mid-tier card.
  - Seven objects: `department`, `employee`, `leave_type` (annual, sick, personal), `leave_balance` (one per employee, tracked type and leave year), `leave_request`, `leave_day` (one line per date, a full day or a half day) and `approval_step`.
  - The route follows the days: up to 3 days goes to the department manager only, more than 3 days to the manager and then HR (`e13`), and a manager's own request goes to the HR manager (`e14`) at step 1. On the last approval the balance's `used_days` (a roll-up of the approved requests) rises and `remaining_days` (entitlement + carry-over - used) falls.
  - Two validation rules: a request cannot be submitted for more days than its balance has left, and a sick request over 2 days needs a certificate.
  - Three personas: `employee` (own rows) and `dept_manager` (own department) carry a row scope; `hr_officer` sees everything except the medical note, which only the requester sees.
  - Seed: 120 requests starting July to October 2026, with 307 day lines, 141 approval steps and 28 balances. The rule that generated it is stated in the card's `$comment`, so every truth can be worked by hand.
  - Run half: 10 questions, 6 operations and 4 agent actions (one confirm-gated); `iterate` adds time off in lieu.
- `packages/qa/scenarios/test/leave-balances.test.ts` (new): this card's own test file.
  - It pins all 10 computed truths and the 9 per-persona truths against hand-worked values, with the derivations beside them.
  - It asserts the mid-tier floor and checks the seed against the rules the card states: a request's days equal its weekday lines, a balance equals its approved requests and the tenure rule, each request's steps match its days and status, and both validation rules hold on every submitted request. It also checks that `LR-0091` really exceeds its balance, so the refused submission is a real refusal.
  - It checks that every `where` in an applied post-state matches no seeded row, so it can only name the row the write creates.
  - It shows that a wrong seed cell and a wrong truth spec in a fixture copy go red against those pins.

## Why

#30479 is one of the six mid-tier cards of the open scenario library. This one covers HR: leave requests whose approval route depends on their length, and balances that move when a request is approved.

## Tests

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test`: 5 files, 73 tests passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck`: exit 0, after building the closure with `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/scenarios^...' build`. `eslint --no-inline-config` on the new test file: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **File names.** The card is `leave_balances.json`, not `leave-balances.json` as the issue spells it: a card's `id` is a snake_case machine name that must equal the file's basename. The test file follows the model's spelling, `leave-balances.test.ts`.
- **No shared-file edit.** Since `travel_expense` landed, `library.test.ts` checks only that the three control cards are present, and the README's "Adding a card" step points at a per-card test file. So this PR touches neither, and the sibling cards no longer conflict on a shared line.
- **No schema field for some floor items.** As with `travel_expense`, the approval flow, "declarative preferred" and a report as distinct from a dashboard have no field in the schema. The card states them in `prompt.detailed` (zh and en) and in `capabilities`, seeds `approval_step` as an expected object, and declares the report under `expect.dashboards`. Nothing in the loader grades them.
- **Capability tags.** Where a tag in the closed tag table of the open scorer PR #30594 fits, the card uses that spelling (`approvals.approval-flow`, `access-security.row-scope`, `dashboards.widget-measures`, `records-forms.lookup`), so those tags are judged once the scorer lands. Tags outside that table read `unscored` there, not failed.
- **Seven operation kinds, six operations.** `file_and_submit_from_text` covers two of them: entry from free text with lines, and the multi-step chain (file the request, add a full day and a morning, submit, route to the manager).
- **Routed approval step not asserted.** The post-state of `file_and_submit_from_text` does not assert the routed step-1 row. A `where` cannot name the new request's id, and `approver e05 · pending` also matches seeded rows.
- **Dates.** `asOf` is 2026-09-30, so October's requests are the upcoming ones and every draft or pending request is for future leave; "last month" is August. Balances belong to leave year 2026/27, which starts on 1 July, so the seed is the whole leave year so far. Days count Monday to Friday; public holidays are out of scope and the `$comment` says so.
- **Reference.** `objectstack-ai/templates` is not attached to this session, so the domain is designed from the card text alone.

`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` set `LR-0098`'s `days` from 5 to 6 in `docs/qa/scenarios/leave_balances.json` and ran this card's test file: 4 of 9 tests failed (the pinned truths, the lines check, the balance check, and the fixture-copy pin, which reads the real card). It then restored the file: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
</details>

<details>
<summary>dispatch-gates --commands (50 commands, local, head 42b3e57a)</summary>

All 50 derived commands exit 0 on head `42b3e57a` (the commit before the `main` merge). The `--ran` reconciliation reads: 50 derived, 50 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, a derived zero because every line recorded its exit code.

Four of them first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET). Each exited 0 after the step it names:

- `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`, after `git fetch --unshallow origin main` (the clone was shallow);
- `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:lean-entry-closure` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, after a full `turbo run build` (119 of 119 tasks).

The merge of `main` (9 commits) touches neither `docs/qa/scenarios/` nor `packages/qa/scenarios/`, and the derivation on the merged head `9bd3d3c9` names the same 50 commands. On that head the scenarios tests (5 files, 73 tests) and typecheck pass again.

Changed lines: 1342 (+1342 / -0, 2 files), under the 3000 threshold.
</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (Not touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (eslint on the new test file locally; the repo-wide run is CI's.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (`@objectstack/scenarios` is `private: true` and publishes nothing, so no changeset, `skip-changeset`, as `travel_expense` landed.)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
